name: jmrc-triangle-intake
description: Robins Interiors & Design — Triangle Kitchen cabinet intake / selection form. A guided, picture-led wizard employees walk through to capture a customer's Triangle cabinetry choices (door construction, style, species, finish, box, drawers, detailing, ventilation, accessories) and hand off to the designer. No pricing. React + Vite + TypeScript + Zustand, JMRC house style, branded PDF export, suite sign-in + shared cloud projects.
